topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I shouldn't have left the card out. It was a careless mistake, the kind that happens when you're running on too little sleep and too much everything else. The flowers were meant to be a surprise, a simple gesture to brighten the day, but now they're just a puzzle without an answer. I can only hope the message is clear enough through the choice of blooms—tulips, for their simplicity and cheer. But without the words, it's all just a silent offering, open to misinterpretation. I wish I could take it all back and start again, this time with the right words in hand. Perhaps if I act quickly, I can still make it right.
